newsitem.title: USA: Spy for South Korea said arrested in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Spy for South Korea said arrested in U.S.

text.p: A U.S. naval intelligence officer has been arrested in Fort Myers, Virginia on charges of spying for South Korea, CBS News reported on Wednesday.
CBS said Robert Kim, a naval intelligence officer for the past 20 years, was arrested at a reception on Tuesday night and charged with passing secret documents to South Korea.
It said Kim, who was born in South Korea, would be arraigned before a federal magistrate on Wednesday.
No official comment on the report was immediately available.
